items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: Dizzy got invited to Benny Carter, you remember Benny, invited Dizzy to dinner up in Baldwin Hills so Dizzy took me as a guest. So I asked Benny, I said, “Man we were playing out here maybe two months at a time, can I study arranging with you?”

ctx.x: Okay. So you’d be then surprised if something didn’t work? Is that a fair statement?

Well you might make a mistake and have to correct it during the rehearsal. But most of the time I proofread it myself and, you know, I’d check it out on a keyboard to make sure the voicings were right. But I don’t write at the piano and so I hear the music in my head. I hear the band playing. When I first — my first attempts at composition were terrible. Awful. Until I went with Dizzy. And I was playing at the Jazz Workshop in San Francisco. And I remember coming home one night to the hotel. It was one night when…
Wow. Didn’t he do the thing with Thelonious Monk or something?
